# i18n Key Management

## Current file structure

All keys live in a single flat object per locale. Files use `.js` (not `.ts`).

```
src/i18n/
  index.js          ← aggregates locales, imported by src/boot/i18n.js
  en-US/
    index.js        ← all English strings (flat export default {})
  zh-TW/
    index.js        ← all Traditional Chinese strings (same keys)
```

## Domain file format

```js
// src/i18n/en-US/index.js
export default {
  failed: 'Action failed',
  success: 'Action was successful',
}
```

```js
// src/i18n/zh-TW/index.js
export default {
  failed: '操作失敗',
  success: '操作成功',
}
```

## Adding a new key

1. Add the key to `src/i18n/en-US/index.js` (maintain alphabetical order).
2. Add the matching key to `src/i18n/zh-TW/index.js`.
3. Both sides must be updated together — never add a key to only one locale.

## Usage in components

```js
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n'

const { t } = useI18n()
// template: {{ t('some_key') }}
```

Locale switching is managed in `src/layouts/MainLayout.vue` via `useI18n().locale`.

## Rules

- Keys: `snake_case`
- Values: natural language for the target locale
- Keep keys alphabetically sorted (no automated hook yet — sort manually)
- Do not hardcode UI strings in components; always use `t(...)`
- en-US and zh-TW must stay in sync at all times
